batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b A Nehra

batting.name: MEK Hussey

balls.text: slower ball on a good length on off and middle, and Dhawan swats it away to deep midwicket

full-toss outside off and Dhawan puts it away brilliantly, gets his back foot across and deep in his crease, clears his front leg, and goes down on one knee to slog-sweep it over the midwicket boundary
sees him making room again and bowls a yorker right by his feet. Dhawan can only push it to mid-off
bouncer now, well directed. May have seen Dhawan stepping away to make room and followed him, and his attempt at a swatted pull comes to nothing
fuller now and Hendricks goes for the big drive, doesn't middle it at all and it slices over mid-off, to his right
back of a length in the corridor, angling in. Looks to dab it to third man, doesn't get any bat on it

slower ball angled away from Axar, and it gets his wicket. Slashes away from his body and only manages a top edge that loops to the right of Dhoni, who settles himself under it and completes a simple catch
down the track again and this time Bravo follows him with the blockhole ball. Rishi clips it to long-on
down the track and finds the Bravo slower ball right in his slot. It's wide outside off, and it gives him plenty of swinging room to get down low and launch over wide long-on
low full-toss wide outside off, Axar plays a bottom-handed drive to long-off
down the track now and Bravo beats him with a very full, wide ball slanted a long way across him

slower ball, angled across Axar, who swings at it and launches it high over wide long-on. Just about clears the rope, beating Faf who moves to his left and leaps to try and complete a back-hand catch with his right hand stretched over his head
sweeps now, from outside off to deep backward square leg
a bit of flight now outside off stump and Axar gets his front leg out of the way to launch that down the ground, hard. Long-on is too wide to stop that
nice and slow from Jadeja, who saw Rishi coming. Doesn't get to the pitch, and it stays with the angle and cramps him, and he stabs it away towards point
tossed up on middle stump, driven to long-on
tossed up outside off, slapped hard through cover but Hussey dives to his right from extra cover to stop it
flat, fired into the pads. He saw Rishi looking to make a bit of room. Hurried into a flick, he misses, and the ball ricochets off his pad into the off side
slower ball wide outside off, Rishi half-sweeps, half-drives to long-on
back of a length on middle and off, worked away towards deep midwicket
down the track and Bravo bowls it right up to him, outside off. Jabs it away through midwicket
back of a length outside off, slapped away to sweeper cover
slower ball outside off. Rishi comes forward, lets it come on, and dabs it towards short third man
full and wide, flat-bat drive to sweeper cover
fullish, angled in towards off stump. Dhawan defends with the turn towards backward point
slow and a bit of flight outside off. Dhawan presses forward and pushes it towards backward point
shortish ball, turns sharply outside off. Rishi moves away from the line and taps down on the top of the bounce to place it to the right of short third man
tossed up outside off, driven to extra cover
flat, angled in towards off and middle. Dhawan gets down low, gets his front leg out of the way, and sweeps powerfully to the midwicket boundary
down the track now, gets to the pitch of the flighted ball outside off and drives to long-off
sharp turn, starts from middle and leg and turns down the leg side. Axar shapes to flick and decides to ignore the ball instead
flatter now, goes with the angle towards off stump. Axar stays leg side and punches it through cover
a bit of flight and Axar runs down the pitch to swipe it from middle stump and find the gap between long-on and deep midwicket
short outside off, chopped away to the right of sweeper cover
a bit of flight now, outside off, and he stretches out to play a checked drive to mid-off
length ball turning in towards leg stump. Rishi looks to make room, is cramped up, and ends up defending softly into the off side
length ball on the pads, tucked away through backward square leg
full, angling down the leg side. Axar can't connect with the flick
flat on leg stump, straightens after angling in sharply, and Rishi stays back, defends with the turn into the off side

flat, a touch short, and Miller rocks back to pull, gets a lot of power on it but hits it in the air, and Jadeja runs to his left from deep midwicket to complete an excellent catch, diving low to his left and taking it with both hands
now Axar is down the track and Negi bowls it quick and flat. Taps it into the on side to take the single
down the track and Negi slows it down, angles it into the batsman. Turns in and hits him on the pads as he misses the flick
too full to sweep from outside off and Miller yorks himself. It goes under his bat, beats the keeper, and runs away for four byes
tossed up on off stump, swept to deep square leg
tossed up on middle and leg, defended towards short midwicket
quicker now, goes with the angle into the pads, and he clips it away through square leg

stumping appeal from Dhoni. Quick hands from him behind the stumps. That was tossed up invitingly outside off and Axar stretched out to drive, didn't get to the pitch, and it turned away from him and beat his bat. His foot was in the air momentarily but he brought it down before Dhoni could flick the bails off
slow again and Miller is in position a long time before he can play a controlled, checked paddle from outside off towards square leg
slower now, on off stump. Miller is on the front foot but he has to wait for the ball to come on before he can push it into the covers
length ball on middle stump, worked away through the leg side
down the track and Jadeja fires one into his pads. Gets his front leg out of the way and nudges it into the on side
there's the reverse-sweep. Picked the right ball for it, took it from just outside off and slapped it away to the backward point boundary
a touch shorter and he has time to let it come on and nurdle it to deep backward square leg
on the back foot now, it's a length ball on a tight off-stump line. Defended carefully into the on side
sees him coming down the track and bowls it flatter and a touch shorter. Good use of the wrists to tuck it away through square leg
length ball spinning in towards off stump, worked away through square leg
quickish again and Axar is on the back foot to a length ball. Pushes hurriedly at it to send it rolling towards long-on
this one's a bit quicker, and Axar is hurried into a defensive poke, and the ball turns and hits the shoulder of his bat and rolls into the off side
nice flight on off stump. Axar comes forward, lets it spin, and defends with soft hands towards slip
tossed up on off stump, driven to long-off
a touch shorter and he goes on the back foot to work it against the turn through midwicket
tossed up nice and slow outside off. Axar stretches forward to block into the off side
length ball outside off, pushed towards short cover for a sharp single

squared him up! That was a flat ball angled in towards middle and off, and Maxwell was neither forward nor back. It spun sharply away from him and past his outside edge as he pushed at it feebly, and hit the top of off stump
and again. This time the line is straighter and it hits him on the pad. Muted lbw appeal from Jadeja
looks for the reverse-sweep immediately. The shot was on, but he's through it too quick and it pops down softly off the back of the bat
a bit straighter and he goes on the back foot to tuck it away to deep backward square leg
back of a length, turns in from outside off, defended into the on side
a bit slower and Miller stretches out to lap-sweep to long leg
quickish length ball on off stump, defended off the inside half of the bat
flat, angled in towards off and middle. Defended into the on side

gone! That's another lovely bit of flight from Ashwin. Sees Gurkeerat skip down the track and defeats him with his trajectory again. The ball dips and turns sharply down the leg side and Dhoni does the rest
a touch short, and Gurkeerat rocks back in a flash to play the orthodox late cut to the right of short third man
fired in quicker, turns down the leg side
lovely flight from Ashwin, dips on Gurkeerat as he stretches out to defend, turns in sharply and pops up off his pad and Dhoni makes a polite appeal for caught behind
slower ball angling away from Maxwell, who looks to steer it to third man and doesn't get any bat on it
length ball on leg stump, tucked away towards deep midwicket
lovely length in the corridor, angling away to beat the batsman. Gurkeerat's footwork isn't up to it, and he pokes at it with an angled bat
length ball on off stump, comes forward to push towards point

fullish on middle and leg, and that's a super shot from Gurkeerat, simply gets his front pad out of the way and brings his bat down nice and straight, shows a full face, and sends it skimming away between bowler and mid-on
length ball on middle stump, defended to mid-off
full outside off. Gurkeerat comes forward to steer towards deep point
flat and full just outside off. Looked like the outswinging arm ball, and Gurkeerat defends with a straight bat back towards the bowler
a bit slower and Maxwell sweeps to deep backward square leg
down the track now and Ashwin bowls it quicker, hurrying him into a defensive push towards midwicket
a bit more air this time, slow, and a fair amount of turn from outside off. Maxwell tucks it carefully to short midwicket
length ball, fairly flat on a tight off-stump line. Maxwell blocks it back to the bowler
length ball, a bit more width this time, and Gurkeerat comes forward and drives on the up, finds the gap between point and cover
back of a length outside off, poked away to point
off-stump yorker, a bit of outswing, and Maxwell jams down on it and steers it towards third man
length ball outside off, a bit of curve away. Gurkeerat pushes at it with an angled bat and hits it uppishly towards point
short ball angling into off and middle. Gurkeerat hops in the air to block it back to the bowler
gone! That was full and wide and Vohra goes after it hard, throws his hands at the ball and ends up slicing it high in the air, straight to third man
shortish outside off, Maxwell slashes and misses
short ball, sits up on off stump, and there's something reminiscent of Ricky Ponting in Maxwell's flourish after dismissing the pull to the midwicket boundary
fullish on middle and off, defended towards short cover
another lovely delivery, finds that in-between length and the angle away beats Maxwell's uncertain push
in the blockhole on off stump, jabbed down towards midwicket

and he strikes first ball. It was a good length ball angling away from Bailey, and he pokes at it hesitantly, with his feet moving after his hands went at the ball, and Dhoni dives low to his right to pouch the edge
down the track now, and Ishwar shortens his length a bit, on that fourth-stump line, forcing Vohra to slice uppishly to the right of third man
slower ball outside off. Vohra pokes at it with no footwork, is beaten. May have moved away a touch
length ball outside off, Vohra plays a good-looking on-the-up punch towards backward point, where it hits Jadeja in the knee as he bends to field it
slower ball now, back of a length, comes in a touch towards leg stump. Bailey goes back to flick it, ends up inside-edging into his thigh pad
short again, a bit of width too. Bailey cuts hard but straight to point
short ball outside off, sits up for Bailey to pull witheringly to the midwicket boundary
fired in a bit quicker, angling into middle stump. Bailey stays in his crease and whips it towards short fine leg
length ball on leg stump, easy pickings for Bailey, who swivels at the hips to half-sweep, half-pull it to the long leg boundary
down the track, clips this leg-stumpish ball to the left of short fine leg
back of a length, angled in from wide of the crease, worked away off the back foot through the leg side

steps towards the leg side to make a bit of room and Negi spots that and bowls it slow, loopy and wide outside off. Saha reaches out to try and hit it over the off side, doesn't hit it cleanly - it turned a fair amount too - and ended up spooning a simple, loopy catch to cover
shortish, goes with the angle into the body, and Saha opens up at the hips to pull it towards deep square leg
back of a length, gets up to chest height. Saha rides the bounce and knocks it down to the right of third man
short this time and Saha rocks into position in a flash to pull it over the square leg boundary
again, he's kept it there or thereabouts, in that channel outside off, just back of a length. This one shapes away slightly, and Vohra dabs it away to third man
and again, some bounce. Saha stays next to the line and steers it to third man
back of a length, close to off stump, a bit of bounce on this occasion. Saha gets back and across and dabs it behind square and sets off for a single but Vohra sends him back
back of a length outside off, gets on his toes to push that towards point
fullish on off stump, clipped to mid-on
flat, angling down leg, tickled to short fine leg and they run a quick single, taking on the not very sprightly Ashish Nehra
dragged down short, loads of width, Saha flat-bats it to the cover point boundary
length ball outside off, driven to cover
a bit slower and a bit of air, Saha steps out and drives inside-out to cover
back of a length outside off, slapped to point

full and wide and Raina slices it away with an open face past short third man, who falls to his left and fumbles a fairly straightfoward fielding effort. I'm not sure who the fielder was, but anyway, a terrible final act in a terrible season for Kings XI
back of a length slower ball wide outside off, Dhoni steers it to third man
down the track now, converts this ball into a full-toss, and lifts it over long-off

whoa. That's the sort of shot we haven't seen Dhoni play too often recently. It's another slower short ball outside off, and he moves a long way across and swings his body around, feet in the air, to whip/pull/scoop it over the fine leg boundary
slower ball, back of a length outside off, defended towards point off the back foot
full slower ball on off stump, Dhoni plays a checked drive to sweeper cover

short ball, slower ball out of the back of his hand, this one sits up outside off and gives Dhoni ample time to rock back, take his helmet off, run his hand through his hair, put his helmet back on, and then pull it to the square leg boundary
back of a length on off stump, jumps back to whip to midwicket with a lot of bottom hand
shortish slower ball outside off, Dhoni plays what you could term a defensive pull to midwicket
length ball outside off, and he goes back and across to poke it to point
short ball outside off, pulled to wide long-on
in the blockhole on middle stump, jabbed back to the bowler
short ball outside off, pulled to the right of long leg
short ball angled into the body, it sits up at waist height and Dhoni swivels to pull powerfully to the backward square leg boundary
short slower ball, pulled to deep midwicket
length ball on the pads, tucked away to deep square leg
length ball on off stump, quietly dabbed to the right of backward point
back of a length outside off, poked away to the right of point
back of a length on off stump, jumps in the air to defend into the on side with a turn of his wrists
low full-toss on off stump, pushed to mid-off
yorks himself. Comes down the track, making room, and Rishi bowls it right up in the blockhole to sneak under his bat and bowl him as he tries to stab it away into the off side
back of a length on off stump, whipped away to the left of deep midwicket
sees Faf coming down the track and bowls a slower bouncer wide outside off. Faf can't do anything with it, just lets it go

length ball on off stump, and that's a nice shot from Faf, shuffling across to whip it between deep backward square leg and deep midwicket, and it's Sandeep, running to his right from the latter position, who makes the diving stop
down the track now, driven to long-off
full on the stumps, turned around the corner towards square leg
down the track and he swats the loopy full-toss to deep midwicket
full, angling down the leg side, tickled away to the left of deep backward square leg
a touch shorter and he goes back in his crease to tuck it away into the leg side and bring up his half-century
tossed up outside off, too wide for Faf to work into the leg side and it turns in and hits his front pad
length ball on the pads, worked away towards deep square leg
short now and du Plessis is deep in his crease immediately to pull to the left of the diving midwicket fielder
sees him coming again and bowls it quick and flat at his feet. Pokes it away towards extra cover
back of a length on off stump, chopped towards point

now he comes out of his crease, gets his front leg out of the way, and swings through the line to loft it back over the bowler's head, carries all the way for six. Just a lovely, smooth swing of the bat
flat, round-arm ball on middle stump. Faf hangs back, making a bit of room, punches to extra cover
quickish length ball on off stump. Raina dabs it towards backward point, wants a single, Faf sends him back

down the track comes Raina and Maxwell bowls it quick and flat on leg stump. Raina brings down a straight bat and chips it over the bowler, and they take two while long-on covers the distance to his right
length ball outside off, whipped away through square leg
tossed up on leg stump, swept to deep square leg
shortish outside off, slapped to backward point
tossed up slow and loopy on off stump, worked with the turn through square leg
quickish length ball close to off stump. Du Plessis hangs back and chops it towards point
full on the pads, clipped to deep midwicket. This is like the middle overs of a 90s ODI
skips out of his crease, makes a bit of room to drive inside-out to sweeper cover
down the track, swipes with the turn from off stump to long-on, all along the ground
fuller and quicker on off stump, Faf plays a quiet checked drive through the covers
shortish on off stump, and Faf rocks back to pull to the midwicket boundary. Excellent weight transfer, swivelling through the hips
length ball outside off, lets it come on and steers it to deep point
fires it into the blockhole as Faf leaves his crease, and he clips it to midwicket
fullish ball outside off, checked drive to long-off
length ball close to off stump. Raina presses forward, lets it come on, and dabs it towards backward point
slower ball outside off, quite full. Faf jabs at it with an angled bat to slice it to the left of point, where Maxwell reaches out with one hand and fails to cut it off
length ball on middle and off, Raina comes forward to play a defensive push to long-on
slowish delivery angled into middle and leg, Faf plays the lap=sweep towards fine leg
length ball on off stump, nudged with the turn to deep square leg
a touch short, angling into leg stump, and Faf goes deep in his crease to pull to deep midwicket
full and flat, fired down the leg side. Faf tries to paddle it fine, doesn't get bat to it
loopy delivery outside off, worked with the turn to long-on
flat, angled into the pads, worked away to deep square leg
tossed up outside off, presses forward, lets it spin into him, and dabs it towards short third man
tossed up outside off, comes forward to stab it away towards point
back of a length outside off, punched towards point
dropped! That was a shortish ball that stopped on Raina, who popped the back-foot punch in the air to the right of the bowler, who stuck his hand out but couldn't grab on to the ball
tossed up outside off and Faf plays the no-look over-the-head lap-scoop to the left of the keeper
length ball on the pads, tucked away very fine - Hendricks is very square at long leg, and he can't cut it off even with a desperate dive
floats one full and down the leg side. Not sure if Raina got any bat on that with the attempted sweep. Ran away towards short fine leg, must have been off the keeper
on the pads now, nudged away towards deep square leg
back of a length, a long way down the leg side

slower ball outside off, dabbed off the front foot towards cover point and they sneak a quick single. They've gone to the third umpire because Miller ran in and hit the stumps direct with his underarm flick but Raina was a long way home. I don't see why umpires keep going upstairs for these sort of decisions.
another slower ball, looks to pull, doesn't middle it, goes off the inside half of the bat to short midwicket
down the track now, it's a slower ball outside off, and he ends up dragging the attempted cover drive down the ground, past the bowler
length ball on off stump, pushed to mid-off
back of a length outside off, punched towards short cover

back of a length on middle and off and that is a super shot from Raina. Went deep in his crease and punched it with a straight bat to find the gap to the left of mid-on and beat deep midwicket haring to his right on the boundary

tossed up slow and alluringly, and Faf comes down the track and it becomes a low full-toss that he whips back towards the bowler, who gets down to his right and deflects the ball towards midwicket with his hand
slowish length ball on the pads, tucked away towards deep midwicket
tossed up slow, angling down leg, sweeps and the man at backward square leg - Bailey - dives to his left to get a hand to it and prevent the boundary
down the track, Gurkeerat follows him with the full ball at the feet, but he gets his front leg out of the way and swings down a straight bat to lift the ball over mid-on
tossed up on off and middle, defended to mid-on
length ball angling in towards off and middle. Raina shuffles across to clip it through backward square leg
not really short enough to pull, but he sits back and uses his wrists to whip it from an off-stump line and juuuuust about clear short midwicket
back of a length outside off, steered to third man
bouncer, ends up angling down the leg side. Raina moves across to try and pull, can't connect
length ball on off stump. Faf sits on the back foot to dab it down to third man
back of a length on off stump, no room this time, defended carefully to short cover
back of a length outside off, enough width for du Plessis to slap him away through the covers off the back foot
back of a length on off stump, hops in the air to defend towards short cover
length ball outside off and Raina leans on it and simply shows it a full face to send it running away between cover and mid-off
back of a length on leg stump, tucked away through midwicket
fullish on middle stump, whipped to short midwicket
back of a length on off stump, worked away through square leg off the back foot
length ball outside off, swings away from Faf, who ignores it through to the keeper
full outside off and Raina presses forward and plays a firm, pleasing, high-elbow drive to cover
bowled him! That was back of a length on off stump, not enough width for the back-foot punch, and he ends up pushing at it with an angled bat and inside-edging into his stumps
down the track comes McCullum - familiar sight, that - and Hendricks slants it a long way away from him. He reaches out to carve it over the off side and edges it over short third man
bouncer angled across McCullum, who sways his upper body out of the way
full on leg stump, whipped away between midwicket and mid-on
back of a length on off stump, pushed into the covers for a quick single

gone! That's the perfect delivery, angling away into the corridor, the length leaves Hussey's feet rooted to the crease, and he pokes at it with an angled bat and edges to the keeper. A hint of shape away as well
length ball on off stump. Hussey is a bit early on the attempted cover drive and it rolls off the inside half of his bat towards midwicket
length ball on middle stump, defended to short midwicket
back of a length, a bit of inswing to cramp McCullum, who's looking to cut. Ends up chopping it down towards backward point
length ball outside off, Hussey leans his head over the ball to drive, but ends up slicing it off the outside half of it towards third man
